decompilation_defects_corrected: the decompilation widens the source to a double before the store; the assembly moves the four source bytes with one word move, so the model copies the raw four bytes
the flag half word written on the inline path keeps the live bit and clears every other bit; the staging model wrote the whole word, and the corrected model writes the half word
